title: Ella and Lena: insecurities and strengths
summary: He compares their self-consciousness, Ella's drive to improve and Lena's sensitivity.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Well, did you go to Ella after that?
After that, yes.
Well, that must have been a pleasure, working with Ella.
Well, it was a pleasure working with her, too.
I didn't mean that, but I meant that Ella is such a wonderful musician.
Yes.
That, I mean, it is a pleasure to work back of somebody that can do what she could do.
Oh, yeah, well, she has her little ways, too. She is self-conscious of herself.
I know.
Which is -- she shouldn't be, at all.
She lacks the confidence, and she should have all the confidence in the world.
And, like, she knew she wasn't as pretty as Lena Horne.
That's right.
But she sounded better.
Oh, yeah, nobody is going to sound better than --
No, nobody is going to sound like Ella.
Right.
And Lena had her own thing she does. And what she does, she does well.
Yes.
And she puts it across.
Sure.
She does beautiful, you know?
Yeah, she's inimitable in her own fashion.
Right, see. But you could come up and say, 'Oh, yeah, Lena Horne and so and so and so, you could see that -- you're thinking about beauty, which you wouldn't be thinking about that. And I used to --
Because she'd be very sensitive.
Yeah, she's very sensitive on things like that. And she could see you talking and think you were
talking about her, bad things, which you wouldn't have to be talking about her. And I think she kind of worried herself more, like that.
During her whole career, I suppose.
Yeah, you know?
Yeah.
And I used to tell her all the time, 'Go ahead and sing. Ain't nobody talking bad about you.'
Yeah.
They love you, you know?
Yeah. Yeah, really, it's a lot of modesty in her, because to have the talent she has --
Oh, sure.
A whole lot of people would have thought, 'What can they say?'
Well, that's it.
When I sing like I sing.
Well, that's right, that's right.
You know?
But Ella was always trying to improve, everything she did, she was trying to improve herself.
I know.
And she wanted people to love her.
I know.
And like that.
She's a very conscientious person.
She's beautiful to me, one of those things.
Yeah. But, still, it made for a little tension on the job.
Oh, yeah, it made [Tommy] uptight.
Yeah, because if she's anxious, it made everybody a little uptight.
